# Retention is the foundation of growth | Elena Verna

## Transcript

Lenny Rachitsky (00:00:05):
Elena, why do you say retention is the foundation of growth?

Elena Verna (00:00:12):
Because acquisition without retention is a leaky bucket. If users do not come back, nothing upstream matters. I tell every team to measure weekly cohorts before touching acquisition channels. Retention compounds; acquisition does not.

Lenny Rachitsky (00:01:40):
How do you define activation?

Elena Verna (00:01:45):
Activation is the moment a user first experiences the core value of the product. You find it by interviewing retained users and looking for the shared early action. Then you instrument that action and remove every step before it. Activation is the leading indicator of retention.

(00:03:10):
Habit loops matter more than feature launches. A trigger that meets the user at a real moment of need beats a scheduled notification every time. Loops are how you turn retention into a growth engine.
